notes.title: Input Buffer
notes.content: [p]A much needed new feature has been implemented. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Input buffering![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This will make the game a little [b]more forgiving[/b] when handling inputs.[/p][p][b]If you press the jump, dash or attack buttons a little early, the game will now execute those inputs when allowed.[/b][/p][p](Thanks again, Tim!)[/p][p][/p][p]This, along with previous updates, will make the gameplay smoother and be more forgiving on the players.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy the new grace period![/p][p][/p][p]PS[/p][p]If something feels off please let me know. [/p]

notes.title: Update! Dashing out of attack recovery animation + Performance Improvements
notes.content: [p]A few updates based on feedback.[/p][list][*][p]Now able to dash out of the attack recovery animation. Pressing dash after using the basic attack will let you instantly dash away or towards your target. (Thanks Tim!)[/p][/*][*][p]1 old save file will be kept alongside the main save and backup files. Just in case you made a mistake and the autosave kicked in before you could quit the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Billboard light Placement. The lights align with the billboard again.[/p][/*][*][p]General performance improvements. HOPING that this makes the game run better and at a locked 60fps (For Steam Deck at the very least).[/p][/*][/list][p]If you're having any issues please let me know.[/p][p]That's all for now! [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Save Backup Update
notes.content: [p]A couple of updates:[/p][list][*][p]The game will now create a backup save file. [/p][/*][*][p]Safer saving system to mitigate chances of corrupting save file.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: New save system
notes.content: The saving method has been changed. The game now uses a .sav file instead of .res. This will be reset your game's progression but will make the game less vulnerable to malicious exploits. Please contact me if you have any further issues. Thanks!

notes.title: Small Fixes Update
notes.content: Optimized particle effects to be less resource hungry

notes.title: Calamity Lag fix
notes.content:
The screenshake was causing lag in the first few calamity rooms. I've taken them out for the time being. The levels shouldn't lag as much now. Please let me know if you are still experiencing issues. 
Thanks for your time!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
The Wind’s Path Demo on Steam has been updated with some badly needed fixes.
Endless Project Games is still accepting feedback from anyone who plays the demo. So don’t be shy!

These fixes include the following:
[list]
[*] New tutorial - Added a new tutorial to teach players more of the game’s mechanics.
[*] Smoother Difficulty - Eased some of the entry levels to ease players into the main game. 
[*] Increased Attack Range - The basic wind attack has an increased range. This makes attacking enemies slightly safer because the player can attack from farther back now.
[*] Updated Capsule Art

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259621/1ebe96e1bf408369b07ea67a15ae826f20ba381d.png[/img]

notes.title: Added Tutorial!
notes.content:
[b]A new tutorial[/b] has been added to help people learn the mechanics. 
This should hopefully help ease players into the game. As always any feedback is appreciated! 

Thanks!
